concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-development-resources-batch-processing-advanced-sftp-batch-files-batch-file-naming-and-structure]] — 2020-modified SFTP batch request/result/ACK filename patterns, platform-scoped sequence and CSV structure reference; FH field-9 requiredness conflicts with the common request-file table, and ACK-generation wording needs the dedicated ACK guide (2026-09-15 snapshot).
warnings: Naming page describes ACK posting after errors, but the dedicated ACK guide documents ACK generation on successful and failed validation; do not infer ACKs occur only on errors.
Duplicate or skipped submission-platform sequence numbers can reject a file; an ACK next-number value after errors can be guessed or incorrect, so do not advise blind resubmission.
Filename/result suffix and ACK validation do not prove encryption, file processing of every line, or payment/payout outcome.

Naming raw line 97 calls FH field 9 optional, but common batch-request-file raw lines 46–56 mark FH field 9/FileType required; keep FileType populated while applying placeholder delimiters only to genuinely optional fields.
